question: Can a 32.139B-parameter sparse MoE be made to behave like a finite working-set workload on a constrained-RAM host by pinning shared weights, caching a bounded expert hot set, and streaming cold experts without hiding routing churn, SSD traffic, KV growth, or foreground damage?
frozen_hypotheses: Activated parameter count is an execution-width statement, not a residency guarantee over a token trajectory.
Under uniform routing, the expert union rapidly approaches all 128 experts per layer even though only 8 are active for one token.
Routing skew creates a measurable expert-hotset cache opportunity; stronger skew should reduce cold-expert traffic at fixed cache size.
Expert cache size exposes a finite-RAM pressure knee between resident bytes and backing-store traffic.

Unlike dense FR-BONSAI-001 decode, sparse MoE can reduce per-token weight traffic if routing locality is exploitable, but can collapse toward storage-sized residency or SSD thrash if expert locality is weak.
physical_stop_conditions: foreground task is killed or becomes unresponsive
memory pressure enters uncontrolled full stall
expert residency cannot be observed with sufficient completeness
runtime eagerly materializes or pins weights in a way that invalidates the intended cache intervention
I/O queueing invalidates the bounded-latency assumption
model correctness cannot be held constant across reference and treatment
nonclaims: No physical run is performed by this PR.
No claim that stock vLLM or Transformers exposes safe per-expert eviction controls.
No claim that 3.827B active parameters implies 3.827B-parameter resident memory.
No claim that the synthetic 768 MiB runtime/KV reserve represents the user's host.
No claim that any expert-cache policy is faster than full residency.
No host process is killed, signaled, or reconfigured by this PR.

comparison_surface.comparison_dimension: trajectory-level weight traffic shape under bounded residency
comparison_surface.dense_failure_shape: nonresident dense blocks are revisited every decode token
comparison_surface.sparse_failure_shape: selected experts are sparse per token but cache misses can grow with weak routing locality
comparison_surface.prohibited_interpretation: Do not rank model quality or raw throughput across architectures from this shadow model.
